dialogue.speaker: Waiter
dialogue.text: Good afternoon! Welcome to Stepnoy Corner. Here's your menu. Are you ready to order or do you need a few more minutes?

dialogue.speaker: Kamila
dialogue.text: We're almost ready, thank you. Excuse me — is the beshbarmak available today?

dialogue.speaker: Waiter
dialogue.text: Yes, it is! It's our most popular dish. Today's version is with lamb and homemade noodles.

dialogue.speaker: Kamila
dialogue.text: Perfect. I'd like the beshbarmak, please. And Zhibek, what about you?

dialogue.speaker: Zhibek
dialogue.text: I'll have the pumpkin manty — I'm vegetarian. And could I get extra sauce on the side?

dialogue.speaker: Waiter
dialogue.text: Of course, no problem. Would you like any starters? Today's soup is mushroom and barley.

dialogue.speaker: Kamila
dialogue.text: Oh, that sounds lovely. I'll have a small bowl of soup as a starter, please.

dialogue.speaker: Zhibek
dialogue.text: Not for me, thanks. But could I have some bread while I wait?

dialogue.speaker: Waiter
dialogue.text: Absolutely — I'll bring some baursak right away. And to drink?

dialogue.speaker: Kamila
dialogue.text: A large black tea for me, please. Not too sweet — just a little sugar.

dialogue.speaker: Zhibek
dialogue.text: I'd love the fresh watermelon juice. Is it freshly squeezed?

dialogue.speaker: Waiter
dialogue.text: Yes, made fresh to order! Any allergies I should know about?

dialogue.speaker: Kamila
dialogue.text: No allergies. Oh — and is there any honey? I love a bit of honey with tea.

dialogue.speaker: Waiter
dialogue.text: We have lovely local wildflower honey — I'll put a small pot on your table. Anything else?

dialogue.speaker: Zhibek
dialogue.text: No, I think that's everything. Thank you!

dialogue.speaker: Waiter
dialogue.text: Excellent! Your starters will be ready in about five minutes. Enjoy your meal!

questions.hint: "a" = one specific countable thing: a black tea (= one cup).

questions.text: What does "freshly squeezed" mean for juice?
questions.hint: Freshly squeezed = juice pressed directly from fresh fruit.

questions.text: What does "on the side" mean when ordering food?
questions.hint: "On the side" = served separately, not mixed with the main dish.
